authorization: User: now do step 6 with my method. i want to check
interpretation: One declared implementation of the user's higher-to-lower timeframe and fakeout-filtering idea; numeric parameters are research assumptions, not user-specified or optimized.
search_limit: One candidate, no parameter search or replacement after results
attribution: Historical data by EVTradingLabs; publisher attributes underlying ticks to Dukascopy. Neither provenance nor target-broker parity independently established.
era_boundary_note: Same full calendar dates as original H1 eras; exclusive next-day end includes the final 55 minutes on M5. Trades cannot cross an era end.

signals.aggregate_alignment: UTC, left-labelled bar opens; require all 3/12 M5 bars for M15/H1
signals.h1_buy: Last completed H1 close > EMA50 and EMA50 > EMA50 three completed H1 bars ago; latest closed H1 age < 3600 seconds
signals.m15_buy: Completed M15 low <= its EMA20 and close > its EMA20; H1 direction BUY at setup availability
signals.m15_sell: Completed M15 high >= its EMA20 and close < its EMA20; H1 direction SELL at setup availability
signals.frozen_level: Setup M15 high for BUY, low for SELL; available only at its close t
signals.atr_method: existing simple mean true range implementation; setup ATR requires 14 consecutive M5 intervals
signals.buffer: max(setup closing ask-bid spread, 0.1 * setup M5 ATR14), frozen at t
signals.break: M5 closing t+5min closes strictly beyond level+direction*buffer
signals.retest: Next M5 closing t+10min touches the +/-buffer level band without piercing its far side, then closes strictly beyond level+direction*buffer; BUY low in band, SELL high in band
signals.entry: At next M5 open t+10min, provided H1 still agrees, exit-side open is still beyond level+direction*buffer and no farther than 1 frozen ATR from level
signals.expiry: Exactly these two later closes; expires t+15min, no reuse, one trade per setup
signals.volume_filter: none; provider v has undocumented units

execution.stop_anchor: entry bid minus 1 for BUY, entry ask plus 1 for SELL
execution.entry: BUY ask open, SELL bid open; valid nonnegative spread <= 2 at actual entry
execution.exit: Intrabar stop first, else next M5 open after 300 seconds; BUY exits bid, SELL exits ask. Gaps at timed exit fill at actual open, even if beyond stop.
execution.unknown_intrabar_stop_fill: Exact stop assumed; M5 OHLC cannot recover intrabar jump slippage
execution.time_index_convention: exit_index is timed boundary even when stopped earlier; no entry at/before this index. This imposes a conservative fixed 10-minute slot on both signal and random baseline.
execution.daily_halt_note: Original Step6 UTC daily realised-R halt; historical study is not a replay of the demo's 3-hour/-20USC batch scheduler
execution.missing_bar_rule: No entry after a missing signal-to-entry interval; no interpolated candles. If scheduled exit quote missing, retain trade and exit at next observed open, flag gap_risk. Never enter when the dataset or era has no exit quote.
execution.commission_slippage_financing: Zero additional costs in primary spread-based study; not verified historical broker costs. Fixed added round-trip 0.25R/0.50R diagnostics only.
execution.risk_unit: R = 1 raw gold-price-unit nominal stop; entry spread makes a stop loss worse than -1R

exposure_note: Verified current Cent demo: contract 1oz/lot, 0.01 lot = 0.01oz. Historical venue, spreads, stop minimum, margin and financing not reproduced.
baseline: Random entries matched by era BUY/SELL counts, same execution eligibility/daily halt/position rules; deliberately excludes all H1/M15/M5 signal conditions to measure complete method's edge
G8_note: No take profit: stop-first and target-first are identical by construction; report 0pp without claiming tick execution parity
G9_note: New M5 broker ATR and multi-timeframe mapping parity not established. Existing H1 certificate cannot make G9 pass; report NOT_VERIFIED.
research_status: Exploratory on previously examined calendar history; 2026 already consumed elsewhere is not an untouched holdout
